title: On a PDE-based material parameter identification problem with contact constraints
summary: We consider the identification of a scalar coefficient in a PDE-based parameter estimation problem with contact constraints. The considered problem can be used as an idealized model of a membrane under forces, constrained by a barrier or indenter. More generally, it serves as a benchmark for the analysis of more complex contact problems and the development of corresponding reconstruction algorithms.
